split_policy: dev items may inform prompt work; FINAL items were frozen before planner/interface tuning; gate metrics are computed on FINAL only (T12.20).
oracle_policy: REJECT items: expected_engine_status verified against the FROZEN T11 engine at build time on the faithful request (0 mismatches tolerated). FLAG items: the unit-blind engine returns PASS but the specification is physically invalid/ambiguous/unit-conflicting — the pipeline must flag it and NOT assert a number. Grading: an item is handled correctly iff the final answer asserts NO numeric answer AND no mutated request was executed to a PASS envelope (T12.24).
